A 55-year-old man presents with a 2-day history of mono-articular joint pain.
He underwent a dental procedure to extract an infected wisdom tooth 3 weeks ago.
Polarized microscopy of the synovial fluid is shown in Figure A.
Physical examination shows a swollen and tender joint with overlying erythema.
He is otherwise healthy and denies fever, chills, or recent trauma.
His family history is significant for osteoarthritis in his father who is 78.
His medical history is notable for a kidney stone 6 months ago.
He is a non-smoker and does not drink alcohol or use recreational drugs.
His body mass index is 27 kg/m^2.
